status: Implemented and verified in simulators; unsigned device build passed

original_icon_white.behavior: Original Soulo preview stays white in light and dark themes. Primary app icon explicitly reuses the unchanged approved PNG for its dark rendition. Glass/Dark alternatives retain their own appearance renditions.

extension_popup.behavior: Compact-width popovers start at a fitted sheet height, capped at 80 percent of available height, and can expand to Large. Generic extension webviews use safe-area bounds with 12pt horizontal margins and a 16pt bottom gap in addition to the system safe area, keeping fixed HTML footers above rounded corners and the Home indicator.
extension_popup.scope: Public UIKit layout applied to all native action popups, not a Cat Catch-specific CSS patch.

platform_navigation_from_extension_pages.reproduction: Loading a platform search directly in the extension-origin WKWebView failed to leave downloader.html?requestId=484 in the local reproduction; retained in popup-navigation-probe.xcresult.
platform_navigation_from_extension_pages.behavior: An explicit platform action from an extension document creates and loads an ordinary browser tab. The original extension tab, URL, WKWebView and JavaScript state stay intact. Further platform switches reuse the ordinary tab.
platform_navigation_from_extension_pages.interaction: Explicit platform selection has a callback even when tapping the currently selected icon. Automatic platform restoration does not replace an extension document. VoiceOver platform paging uses the same navigation route and preserves the URL-input guard.

settings_group.ios16: Nested children use the existing isolated SettingsSubpageLink sheet boundary; newer systems use regular navigation.
settings_group.localization: New short parent title translated in all 50 runtime locales.
